newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Koc Hldg to buy dairy firm SEK.
newsitem.headline: Turk Koc Hldg to buy dairy firm SEK.

text.p: Turkey's leading industrial conglomerate Koc Holding A.S. said the group would buy 68 percent of dairy industry SEK Sat Endastrisi Kurumu Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. which was privatised in late 1995.
Koc group firms would buy a total of 20.4 million SEK shares having a nominal value of 1.02 trillion lira, the Holding said in a statement sent to the Istanbul stock exchange.

"The acquisition value of SEK will be determined later" Koc said, adding that fixed assets of the company were calculated at $58 million at end-1996 and that the company's debts and receivables would also be considered at the time of the takeover.
"Details of the takeover and transfer of shares will be announced after the legal procedures are completed" the statement said.
